key_difference: (D) adds its own in-decode UTF-8 decoding of %80–%FF sequences, a new traits struct that allows non-characters, and only checks percent-encoded separators; (B) relies on valid UTF-8 already being folded, rejects any decoded byte >= 0x80, and pre-checks for literal backslashes on Windows, which are stored in decoded form and which (D) therefore lets through.
